integrity.proof_basis: finite-word renewal identity, Fibonacci algebra, positive association, exact rational spectral root isolations
integrity.reproducibility: checks/check.py independently tests 1200 binomial-parity pairs, 15 full dyadic blocks and exact rational root inequalities

scientific_limitations: Only the particular two binomial-parity sequences under uniformly sampled complete dyadic blocks; correlation is defined for lengths at least two. The prior run-length representations and first moments, and the OEIS A030186 square moment, are credited. Possible implicit earlier spectral or tensor-product formulation remains a priority risk.
title: Positive but exponentially decorrelating binomial-parity Fibonacci transforms
